evals.prompt: Run the wallet browser payment tests and make me a fun video showing the incoming, outgoing, and ecash flows.
evals.expected_output: A validated H.264 montage and contact sheet created only after all selected Playwright tests pass.
expectations: The real mint, melt, and ecash Playwright specs run with video enabled.
The output is a playable 1280x720 H.264 MP4.
The ecash chapter labels sender and receiver without swapping their roles.
The final response links the video and reports the test result.

evals.prompt: The E2E recordings are already in test-results. Recut the demo at 1.5x without rerunning Docker.
evals.expected_output: A new montage rendered from existing recordings with no test stack startup.
expectations: The renderer is invoked with --skip-tests and --speed 1.5.
Existing stable sender and receiver recordings are used.
FFprobe validation and contact-sheet generation complete successfully.

evals.prompt: Record the payment tests, but one of the melt assertions fails. Still give me a clean success montage from whatever passed.
evals.expected_output: No misleading success montage; the failing test and retained Playwright diagnostics are reported.
expectations: The renderer exits when the Playwright run fails.
The response does not present stale or partial footage as a successful run.
Failure video, trace, and screenshot locations are preserved when available.
